G5601.def:
Ἰωβήδ (WH, -βήλ, Lk, l.with; Rec., RV, Ὠβήδ), ὁ, indecl.,
Jo bed (Obed): Mt 1:5, Lc 3:32.†
(AS)

G5602.def:
ὧδε, adv.,
[in LXX for חֲלֹם ,פֹּה ,הִנֶּה, etc. ;]
__1. prop., of manner, so (Hom., al.).
__2. In poets (rarely) and late writers, of place,
__(a) hither (BL, §25, 2): Mt 8:29, Mc 11:3, Lc 9:41, Jo 6:25, al.; ἕως ὧδε, Lc 23:5;
__(b) here: Mt 12:6, Mc 9:1, Lc 9:33, Jo 6:9, al.; τὰ ὧδε, Cl 4:9; opposite to ἐκεῖ, Hb 7:8; ὧδε . . . ἢ ὧδε (ἐκεῖ), Mt 24:23, Mc 13:21; metaphorically, here (i.e. in this circumstance or connection), 1Co 4:2, Ap 13:10, 18 14:12 17:9.
(AS)

G5603.def:
ᾠδή, -ῆς, ή
[in LXX chiefly for שִׁיר ;]
a song, ode, whether sad or joyful; in LXX and NT always in praise of God or Christ: Ap 5:9 14:3 15:3; ᾠ πνευματικαί Ef 5:19, Cl 3:16.†
(AS)

G5604.def:
ὠδίν
(late form of ὠδίς), -ῖνος, ἡ [in LXX for חֵבֶל חֶבֶל (and wrongly for חֶבֶל חֶבֶל, cf. Ac, l.with), חִיל, etc. ;]
a birth pang, travail pain: 1Ts 5:3; metaphorically, of extreme suffering, Mt 24:8, Mc 13:8; ὠδῖνες θανάτου (Sl 18:4 מָוֶת חֶבֶל), At 2:24.†
(AS)

G5605.def:
ὠδίνω
[in LXX chiefly for חוּל, also for חָבַל pi., etc. ;]
to have birthpangs, to travail: Gl 4:27 (LXX), Ap 12:2; metaphorically, Gl 4:19 (cf. συν-ωδίνω).†
(AS)

G5606.def:
ὦμος, οὐ, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for שְׁכֶם, כָּתֵף ;]
the shoulder: Mt 23:4, Lc 15:5.†
(AS)

G5608.def:
ὠνέομαι, -οῦραι
to buy: ὠνήσατο (= cl. ἐπρίατο; see Rutherford, NPhr., 210 ff.; Veitch, see word), with genitive pret., At 7:16.†
(AS)

G5609.def:
ᾠόν
(Rec. ὠόν), -οῦ, τό [in LXX for בֵּיצָה ;]
an egg: Lc 11:12.†
(AS)

G5610.def:
ὥρα, -ας, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for עֵת and in Da for שָׁעָה ;]
__1. any time or period fixed by nature, esp. a season (Hom., Hdt., Plat., al.).
__2. A part of the day, and esp. a twelfth part of day or night, an hour: Mt 24:36, Mc 13:32, At 10:3, al.; accus. in ans. to "when"? (M, Pr., 63, 215; Bl., §34, 8), Jo 4:52, At 10:3, 30 1Co 15:30, Ap 3:3; accusative of duration, Mt 20:12 26, Mc 14:37; inexactly, πρὸς ὥραν, for a season, for a time, Jo 5:35, 2Co 7:8, Gl 2:5; πρὸς καιρὸν ὥρας, for a short season (ICC, in l.), 1Ts 2:17.
__3. A definite point of time, time, hour: Mt 26:45; with genitive of thing(s), Lc 1:10 14:17, Ap 3:10, al.; with genitive of person(s), Lc 22:53, Jo 2:4 7:30, al.; ἡ ἄρτι ὥρα, 1Co 4:11; ἐσχάτη ὥ., 1Jo 2:18; before ὅτε, Jo 4:21, 23 5:25 16:25; ἵνα, Jo 12:23, al.; with accusative and inf., Rm 13:11 (cf. DB, ext., 475b 476b).
(AS)

G5611.def:
ὡραῖος, -α, -ον
(ὥρα), [in LXX for נָאָה, טוֹב, יָפָה, etc. ;]
seasonable, timely, esp. of ripe fruits; hence, blooming, beautiful (both of things and persons): Mt 23:27, At 3:2, 10, Rm 10:15 (LXX, ὥρα).†
(AS)

G5612.def:
ὠρύομαι depon.,
[in LXX for שָׁאַג ;]
of animals (also of men, Hdt., al.), to roar, howl: λέων, 1Pe 5:8.†
(AS)

G5613.def:
ὡς, adverbial form of the relative pron. ὅς, ἥ, ὅ.
__I. As relat. adv. of manner, as, like as, just as, even as;
__1. with a demonstrative, like οὕτως, expressed or understood: οὕτως . . . ὡς, Mc 4:26, 1Co 3:15, Ef 5:28, Tg 2:12, al.; ὡς . . . οὕτως, At 8:32, 1Co 7:17, al.; elliptically (sc. οὕτως, οὕτω), with nom., Mt 6:29, al.; with accusative, Mt 19:19, Mc 12:31, al.; with prep., Mt 26:55, Mc 14:48, Lc 22:52, Jo 7:10, al.; with verb., Jo 15:6, 2Co 3:1, Ef 2:3, 1Ts 5:6, al.; with ptcp. (the ptcp. however not having the special force wh. it has in cl.; see Bl., §73, 5; 74, 6), Mt 7:29, Mc 1:22, Hb 13:17, al.; freq implying opinion or belief, Rm 9:32; so esp, with genitive absol., 1Co 4:18, 2Co 5:20, 1Pe 4:12, 2Pe 1:3.
__2. Before numerals, about, nearly: Mc 5:13, Jo 1:40, At 5:7, al.
__3. Before adjectives and adverbs, how: Rm 10:15 11:33, 1Ts 2:10; with superl., ὡς τάχιστα, as quickly as possible, At 17:15.

__II. As conjunction;
__1. temporal,
__(a) as, when, since: Mc 9:21 14:72, Lc 1:23, Jo 2:9, al.;
__(b) while, when, as long as: Lc 12:58, Jo 12:36, Gl 6:10 (Field, Notes, 191); ὡς ἄν (M, Pr., 167, and see: ἄν), Rm 15:24, 1Co 11:34, Fp 2:23.
__2. Final, in order that; with inf., in order to (M, Pr., 204n), Lc 9:52, At 20:24, Hb 7:9.
(AS)

G5614.def:
ὡσαννά (T, ὠσ-) (Heb נָא and הוֹשֵׁעַ; see Dalman, Words, 220 IL; Gr., 249),
hosanna: Mt 21:9, Mc 11:9-10, Jo 12:13; τ. υἱῷ Δανείδ, Mt 21:9, 15.†
(AS)

G5615.def:
ὡσαύτως
adv.,
strengthened for ὡς (in Hom, at the beginning of a clause, in the form ὣς δ᾽ αὔτως, later in one word), in like manner, just so, likewise: Mt 20:5 21:30, 36 25:17, Mc 14:31, Lc 13:5 20:31, Rm 8:26, 1Tm 5:25, Tt 2:6; with verb to be supplied from context, Mc 12:21, Lc 22:20, 1Co 11:25, 1Tm 2:9 3:8 3:11, Tt 2:3.†
(AS)

G5616.def:
ὡσεί
adv.,
__(a) as if, .as it were, like as, like: Mt 3:16 9:36, At 2:3 6:15, Rm 6:13, Hb 1:12; γίνεσθαι (φαίνεσθαι) ὡσεί, Mc 9:26, Lc 22:44 ([WH] R, mg., om.), Lc 24:11;
__(b) in calculation, and with numbers, about: Mt 14:21, Lc 3:23 9:14, 28 22:41, 59 23:44, At 2:41 10:3 19:7; ὡσεὶ λίθου βολήν, Lc 22:41.†
(AS)

G5618.def:
ὥσ-περ
adv.,
just as, even as: Mt 6:2 20:28, At 3:17, 1Co 8:5, 1Ts 5:3 al.; in protasis, with οὕτως (καί) in apodosis: Mt 12:40, Lc 17:24, Jo 5:21, Rm 5:19, Gl 4:29, Tg 2:26, al
(AS)

G5620.def:
ὥσ-τε
consecutive particle,
__1. with infin., expressing result, so as to: Mt 8:24 12:22, Mc 1:27, Lc 5:7, At 1:19, Rm 7:6, 1Co 1:7, Hb 13:6, al.; of a designed result, Mt 10:1, Lc 4:29, al.; preceded by οὕτως, At 14:1; by τοσοῦτος, Mt 15:33.
__2. C. indic.,
__(a) so that: Gl 2:13, preceded by οὕτως, Jo 3:16;
__(b) so then, therefore: Mt 12:12, Mc 2:28, Rm 7:4, 1Co 3:7, Gl 3:9, al.
__3. so then, therefore: with subjc., 1Co 5:8; with imperat., 1Co 3:21 4:5, Fp 2:12 1Ts 4:18, 1Pe 4:19, al
(AS)

G5621.def:
ὠτίον, -ου, τό, dimin. of οὖς,
[in LXX for אֹזֶן ;]
an ear: Mt 26:51, Lc 22:51, Jo 18:26.†
(AS)

G5622.def:
ὠφέλεια (WH, -λία), -ας, ἡ
[in LXX for יָעַל hi., בֶּצַע, etc. ;]
__1. assistance, help (Thuc., Plat., al.).
__2. profit, advantage, benefit (Hdt., Plat., al.): Rm 3:1, Ju 16.†
(AS)

G5623.def:
ὠφελέω, -ῶ
(ὄφελος), [in LXX chiefly for יָעַל hi. ;]
to help, benefit, do good, profit: absol., Rm 2:25; οὐδέν (do no good; see Field, Notes, 21), Mt 27:24, Jo 6:63 12:19; with accusative of person(s), Hb 4:2; with dupl. accusative, Mc 8:36, 1Co 14:6, Gl 5:2; pass., Hb 13:9; with accusative, Mt 15:5 16:26, Mc 5:26 7:11, Lc 9:25, 1Co 13:3.†
(AS)

G5624.def:
ὠφέλιμος, -ον
(ὠφελέω),
useful, serviceable, profitable: with dative commod., Tt 3:8; before πρός, with accusative, 1Tm 4:8, 2Tm 3:16.†
(AS)
